question: What capacity retention did the aqueous-processed and the NMP-processed NMC 811 pouch cells show?
rendered: The aqueous-processed NMC 811 pouch cells showed a capacity retention of around 70%, while the NMP-processed NMC 811 cells showed a capacity retention of around 76% after 180 cycles.
